name: pharaonic/laravel-api-idempotency
description: Opt-in HTTP idempotency for Laravel routes: Route::post(...)->idempotent() with atomic database or Redis reservation, request fingerprinting, safe response replay and fail-closed recovery.

suggest.ext-redis: For the redis store with the phpredis client (predis/predis works too).
